title: entityViewSections
responsibility: Selects the existing entity sections for its visual and headless presentation context.

inputs.name: entityViewSections.context
inputs.description: Provides optional entity metadata used to decide whether the APIs label is retained. The implementation reads entity?.category only for that label, and APIs is kept only when the category is exactly pages.

inputs.name: entityViewSections.headless
inputs.description: Selects the pair of section labels removed by the headless checks: true excludes Designs and Evidence, while false excludes Plan and Examples. The visual check can independently exclude Evidence or States as well.

inputs.name: entityViewSections.visual
inputs.description: Selects one label for exclusion: true removes Evidence, and false removes States. Other exclusions still apply independently.

outputs.name: entityViewSections
outputs.description: Returns the remaining section labels as a new array in the canonical order of workspaceSections. The filters remove one of Designs/Plan, one of Evidence/States, and one of Evidence/Examples; APIs remains only when the category is exactly pages.

errors.name: Context access failure
errors.description: An exception thrown while reading context.entity or its category escapes unchanged; the category access is evaluated only for the APIs label. The function does not catch or transform exceptions from those property accesses.
